content: Rala nounaku kerei raramne leke ida man mori wawa'an noro ida
Yono modi lir apinpinha wakuku mo'oni man anulu ki o, maa modi lira mamamal ma'alapa hi akin naisa moro onum pape wakunu. Ma na'ikaka enihe, mapolu hi naise mo'oniwallumhe.
Maeke man anulu ki o, mapolu hi naisa num mame. Maekrara enihe, mapolu hi naise narumhe modi aki ma namdudu.
Horhawa la ilitolle maeke walwalum ma na'alehe ihin walan man tolle hi.

Maeke walwalum ma upun anan aile, na'amoli ai upun anan lernohi agame nin holoor halauk de tolle mam onne. Lo'o hir hi'i onne hir walha rir ri leleher noro upun rira wawa'an. Onne penia nahuwa'an Makromod Lalap akin.

Maeke walwalum ma namlolo kokkoo memehe ono na'alehe ihin walan, ai akin naili'il kokkoo de nauroin Makromod Lalap raram nodi paku ai. Lelere a'alam an hi'i lir napanak Makromod Lalap la ai napanak An ilitolle ai.
Maa, maeke walwalum ma nin morimori nanoin wawa'an mamani, kade ai kemen mormori makun, maa honorok akin makiyedi me'e.
Loikaru panaeku eni hi leke rira morimori wa'an, la ra'alehe yakyaka salsala.
Maa lo'o ri ma kan tolle ihin walinhe, rehirehi ainina meheromo, ai onne kan lernohi Yesus Kristus me'e, la nin sala werek narehi nano ri ma akin ka naili'il Makromod Yesus.
Horok maeke walwalum naran ma nin anna welineme laa wawan lolo kerei nin horok leke kerei ilitolle, horo nahenia hir ho raram mehe,

la ri heri ri wali po'on rira morimori wa'an mamani. Ende hir hi'i ha naise: tolle ananne wawa'an, kokala peina'a noro wawa'an, ilitolle walin man akin naili'il Yesus, paku ri man lernala sus, la radedem hi'i hahaa man wa'an.

Maeke walwalum ma nina anna kan rakan welineme makun, yon horok naran lolo horok onne raram, ono lo'o hirira kamanne hohoo kan horu makun de hir ho wali'ur. Lo'o hir hi'i heheni, hir sala ono larlewenedi rir nou nahenia hir howok Kristus Nin honowok mehe.
Onne kan mehe, lo'o hi ramwali ma naprehen la hir lalaa mamai nakar laa nakar wakunu nano'onyaka ri la rakani ri namehin nin panaeku, de hir wakunu ha ma kan wa'an mamani.
Onne peni ya'u nounaku maeke walwalum ma ka na'ileher makun, ho, moriyana, tolle meheromo kaimehi, leke yon nala leken ri ma kan suk ika wakunu nano'onyaka ika man lernohi Kristus.
Ya aheni heheni ono maeke walwalum heruwali hi akin ka namkene naili'il Yesus de lernohiyedi Hayakyak Makromon me'e.

Lolo ri Kristen enihe, lo'o ma namwalum aile lolo rira meheromo, hi peni man ilitolle, leke yono namwali yodiwara lolo kerei raramne. Hi'i heheni leke kerei raramne paku ilitolle maeke walwalum ma namlolo kokkoo na'alehe ri man ilitolle.

Man leluwai makrana enihe man tolle kerei nin honowok nair wawa'an, wa'an rehi lernala honoor hanawa man wa'an noro naiwe'el man noknokor, rehirehi man leluwai makrana ma nampe'el wakuku la naderre nadaul Makromod Lalap Lirna Wawan eni.

Hi'i heheni ono lolo Horok Lap Lirna aile ma na'ahenia, “Sapi man hamar gandum ihin nano lollo, yono pasun nuranne kawala ya'ane.” Horok aile haenhi ma na'aheni, “Yon mamhene mala naiwe'el ri man howok num honowok.”
Lo'o rin tumdesne man leluwai makrana lolo kerei ida, yon pelek kokale, kokoko ri woro'o wokelu man do'on mouropo aile.
Lo'o an hi'i sala, dadiyala ai lolo kerei raramne kalarna leke ri namehin ma akin naili'il Yesus enihe ramka'uk.

Timotius, ya apanak an'anhedi ki o, lernohi ainu'u nou eniyeni na'akeme, la yon ma'ili maloho ri lolo minim hini'i wenewhe onne. Horhorok! Makromod Lalap noro Makromod Yesus Kristus noro hophopon a'am raram man niliyedi enihe mahar po'on ika.
Yom pelek ma'ono ri namwali man leluwai makrana lolo kerei. Yom lernohi ri namehin nin dohohala. Madiyaka o memen leke num morimori na'amoli moumou dewdewe.
Yono momun oir mehe, maa momunala anggur tarana haenhi, leke yon konoum apinha.
Ri heruwali rira dohohala, heri rauroin mouropedi me'e, kade kar ho'ok kail makun. Enimaa ri namehin rir dohohala, rakan Lere Alam Hono'ok Kanail mene heri do'on rauroin.
Eni namnenehe ri namehin aile man hi'i ha wawa'an, pelek ri nauroin. Enla ri heruwali aile man rira hini'i wenewhe wa'ane, maa ri kar pelek do'on. Rakan lere man mai mene hir do'on rauroin.
